turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I’m okay, but my knee is a bit painful.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: On a scale from 0 to 10, how would you rate the pain?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Maybe around 4 or 5. It’s manageable, I think.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any nausea or feeling like you want to vomit?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I’m not feeling sick at all.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: How’s your throat? Any discomfort from the tube during surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: A bit sore, but I can breathe fine. No problem.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Do you remember anything about the surgery itself?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Not really. I was out cold, I guess.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any other issues you’re concerned about?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I think that’s all. Thanks for checking on me.
